THE VISION

Bridging the gap between skill and opportunity.

Millions of skilled workers lack a formal way to prove their expertise or access fair credit. Karigar creates a voice-first professional identity and community-driven financial system— allowing artisans to build a "Trust Score" and a "Skill Passport" without needing a smartphone or a traditional bank account.

CORE FEATURES

Empowering workers through trust and technology.

Skill Passport

A professional identity built by your voice. No forms, no resumes—just your expertise, structured by AI.

Lending Circles

Community-powered savings. Secure, rotating savings groups to grow your business without the need for banks.

CT Score

Credit based on trust. A fair score that recognizes your reliability and tenure, opening doors to new opportunities.

HOW IT WORKS

From voice to opportunity.

01

Voice-First Intake

Speak naturally in your own language to create your AI-powered Skill Passport.

02

Build Community Trust

Join local lending circles to save and grow your capital alongside other artisans.

03

Earn Your Score

Your reliability and tenure are converted into a CT Score that proves your trustworthiness.

04

Unlock Opportunities

Use your Passport and Score to access better work, fairer loans, and financial tools.

Technology that empowers the underserved.

Professional Identity

Turn years of informal experience into a structured, verified passport that opens new doors.
